description: A direct sub-package of the main application package, treated as a unit with its own public API.
A sub-package of a module whose types other modules may not use.
A test call that fails the build on forbidden access to internals or on dependency cycles.
An @ApplicationModule setting that lists the only modules a module may depend on.
A test annotation that boots one module and its declared dependencies instead of the whole application.
A Spring Modulith tool that generates diagrams from the real module structure.
